interpretive_limits: Near-chance empirical AUC of these probes does not establish zero mutual information or impossibility for all single-pass functions
Knowledge-stratum imbalance is distinct from conflict class imbalance: every split has exactly 50 percent true and 50 percent substituted contexts
Known-only hidden-state/token diagnostics use calibration labels and are evaluated only on validation; no frozen threshold/method change
Full-vocabulary entropy is an originally cached scalar; top10-renormalized entropy is not full-vocabulary entropy
First-token LM-head features arise after the full prefill and are not available for the original earlier layer decision without a different timing boundary
Small known validation cohorts, exploratory comparisons and calibration-fit uncertainty limit causal interpretation
